## Securities and Futures Commission &amp; Securities Commission Malaysia Memorandum of Understanding on Simplified Dual IPO Listing Framework Circular on the Single Submission Arrangement for Dual Listings in Hong Kong

## Preamble

On 23 July 2026, the Securities and Futures Commission ( SFC ) and the Securities Commission Malaysia ( SC ) signed a Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Mutual Recognition of Covered Funds and Simplified Dual IPO Listing Framework ( MoU ).

The MoU facilitates cross-listings of equity securities between Hong Kong and Malaysia, strengthens regulatory collaboration between the SFC and the SC, and establishes a framework for simultaneous IPO listings in both markets.

To support this regime, the SFC and the SC have established a simplified framework for companies seeking simultaneously a primary listing in one jurisdiction and a secondary listing in the other, either on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited ( SEHK ) or the MAIN Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad ( Single Submission Arrangement ).

The streamlined and coordinated application process may benefit applicants seeking simultaneous primary and secondary listings under the Simplified Dual IPO Listing Framework. The framework adopts a single submission model, under which all required application materials are submitted through the regulator of the primary listing. It also provides for a coordinated review process, including a single channel for regulatory comments and applicants' responses arising from reviews conducted by the relevant authorities.

Applicants and their sponsors or recognised principal advisers are encouraged to consult the SFC, SEHK, or the SC, as appropriate, before formally submitting a listing application to discuss the proposed transaction structure and indicative timeline. In particular, an applicant proposing a dual primary listing in Hong Kong and Malaysia may consult the relevant authorities at an early stage regarding the potential application under the Single Submission Arrangement.

The SFC's dedicated team may be contacted at HK-Malaysia-duallistings@sfc.hk, while the SC's dedicated team may be contacted at HK-Malaysia-duallistings@seccom.com.my.

## Other reference materials

For information relating to simultaneous primary and secondary listings in Hong Kong and Malaysia, applicants should refer to this circular together with related guidance materials available on the SEHK website and the SC website, including:

- SEHK's Explanatory Note on Malaysia-incorporated Company's Compliance with Core Shareholder Protection Standards and Other Matters

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

- SC's Guidance for Listing of Hong Kong Companies on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad

## End

1  An overseas issuer seeking a primary listing in Hong Kong must be incorporated in a jurisdiction that is included on SEHK's List of Overseas Jurisdictions of Incorporation.

2  For a secondary listing in Hong Kong, the applicant must be a public company incorporated in Malaysia that is already listed or is the subject of an application for listing on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

3 Referring to an SFC licensed sponsor that has affiliate within the same group who are either recognised principal adviser or a Capital Markets Services Licence holder for the regulated activity of advising on corporate finance in Malaysia, and is allowed by the SC to sign application to the SC.

4 If the Applicant intends to appoint an overseas audit firm as its reporting accountants, please refer to Chapter 2.1 of the Guide for New Listing Applicants. Information on the registration of Hong Kong auditors as PIE auditors and the recognition of non-Hong Kong auditors as PIE auditors can be found on the website of the Accounting and Financial Report Council.
